confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Melbourne price levels for a July (winter, low-to-shoulder season) window; no live menus, booking pages or listings were inspected. Coffee, beer and restaurant anchors are more reliable; hostel and hotel rates vary widely by suburb, event dates and booking lead time. Cocktail and wine were set using their typical multiple of the draught beer anchor because direct knowledge is weaker. FX reading (13 Oct 2026, 4 pm) was taken from the RBA Exchange Rates Overview as reported in search results; the F11.1 table was not opened and no 14 Oct 2026 observation was confirmed.
comparable_city_reasoning: Oceania basis: benchmarked against other large Australian city-centre price levels, with Sydney as a rough cross-check; July is treated as a winter, low-to-shoulder accommodation period.
